title: the-apprentice-learns-its-test-failed
intention: The apprentice learns that the test it was driven against failed, and gets a bounded number of further attempts inside the same conversation.
why: THE APPRENTICE CANNOT LEARN THAT ITS TEST FAILED, AND THE FIELD THAT WOULD SHOW IT READS EXACTLY LIKE SUCCESS. driver.py:279 pins auto_test=False with the comment 'WE run the test, so its result is ours to carry'. aider reflects on self.reflected_message, and the only thing that sets it from a test is `if edited and self.auto_test` at base_coder.py:1616-1622 — so with auto_test off, the driver runs the test AFTER coder.run() returns and nothing ever reaches the model. Measured 2026-08-17: a drive passed max_reflections=1 and recorded num_reflections=0, which reads as convergence and is the opposite — nothing could reach it. A severed feedback loop and a converged one are the same number, which is why this is a defect rather than a missing feature.
traces_to: Telos 5 — build something that is self-improving. An apprentice that reads its own failing test and tries again is that aim at its smallest honest scale; today the loop is severed and the field that would show it (num_reflections) reads 0 for the opposite reason. Secondarily Law 3: `num_reflections: 0` is currently an unmeasured claim of convergence dressed as a measurement.

falsifier.proves_green: PROVE GATE (class invariant): the tester runs the node's proof and emits a validation, verdict and seal from the same hand — cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_driver.py (30 teeth today) grows the teeth for this seam, sealed via TesterDevice().run_proof(..., isolation='netns'). The teeth a hollow build could not pass: the payload carries test_cmd and auto_test and the Coder is constructed with them (asserted through the real _DRIVE arrangement, not a mock of it), a drive whose test fails records num_reflections >= 1, and a drive with max_reflections=0 still records 0 — the cap must remain the thing that stops it. FEEDS-BACK-TO-ORIGIN-ON-FAILURE (class invariant): a red proof kicks back to build at the point of creation (CP2). EXTRA GATE — durability: committed and pushed, on the emit chokepoint. EMISSION GATE: the WATCHME crossing refuses unless cairn/devices/aider_shim/probes/reflection_earns_its_ask.py declares a module-level frozen PROBE carrying both a carry and an enough.
falsifier.proves_red: A drive whose first attempt fails the test records num_reflections >= 1 and at least two asks in the fence's log, with the second ask's payload containing the test's failure text. Wrong-intent horizon: if reflected drives do not raise the applied-and-passing rate above the unreflected baseline over the next 5 driven pieces, the loop is cost without learning and the finding is that the ceiling was the brief, not the feedback.
falsifier.horizon: Five driven pieces. If reflected drives do not raise the applied-and-passing rate above the unreflected baseline drawn from the same drives.jsonl, the loop is cost without learning and the finding is that the apprentice's ceiling was the BRIEF, not the feedback.

how: Compose aider's own reflection loop rather than build a second one beside it. base_coder.run_one already loops `while message:` on self.reflected_message and stops at max_reflections (base_coder.py:932-944); the only thing that sets reflected_message from a test is `if edited and self.auto_test` at base_coder.py:1616-1622, and the driver pins auto_test=False. So: carry the brief's test_cmd as a STRING in the venv payload and construct the Coder with auto_test=True and that test_cmd, leaving the parent's own run_test exactly where it is as the record's authority. Measured constraint that decides the shape (CairnCommons/notes/aiders-own-reflection-loop-is-reachable-and-a-callable-test-cmd-is-not.json): a CALLABLE test_cmd — which would have kept 'WE run the test' literally true — raises TypeError on every system-prompt format, because test_cmd is also concatenated into the prompt unguarded at base_coder.py:1169.

decisions.text: The kick-back cause is gone. e50eb534 moved aider_shim/probes/ to probes_disabled/ only to take the device off the heartbeat while interceptor.py reached into inference_domain internals; ticket 50ad391f4e95 fixed that and is PROVED (interceptor.py:164 now imports nothing from inference_domain). The build, one commit 'e9b0a8d4fb99: build — the probe returns to its berth': git mv cairn/devices/aider_shim/probes_disabled/reflection_earns_its_ask.py cairn/devices/aider_shim/probes/reflection_earns_its_ask.py (mkdir probes first) and git mv cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs_disabled/test_reflection_earns_its_ask.py cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_reflection_earns_its_ask.py; then in proofs/test_reflection_earns_its_ask.py, inside test_the_probe_is_armed_at_the_path_the_TICKET_names, replace the stale ticket path Path.home()/f'dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/{TICKET}.json' with Path(ticket_path('e9b0a8d4fb99')), adding 'from cairn.tools.chain.grammar import ticket_path' inside that tooth (tickets are now named <id>-<slug>.json). Measured 2026-10-13: with the files restored, that tooth is the proof's only red. Nothing else changes. Proof: cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_reflection_earns_its_ask.py. Then PROVEME --proven-by it, hollow seal, verdict, WATCHME (the probe is armed at the ticket's berth), PROVED. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09; approved thru PROVED (Akien 2026-10-12)

It becomes spec = json.loads(Path(ticket_path(TICKET)) with the .read_text(...) continuation on line 123 unchanged. proofs/ exists; mkdir -p cairn/devices/aider_shim/probes first. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

Measured 2026-10-13: cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs_disabled/test_reflection_earns_its_ask.py line 42 binds the probe at module level ('from cairn.devices.aider_shim.probes import reflection_earns_its_ask as probe  # noqa: E402'). This build adds the probe at probes/, so PROVEME's proof_binds_its_subject_at_call_time (cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proof_coverage.py:647) reds that line and the hollow would read UNRAN. In the moved proof, that line becomes exactly 'probe = None  # bound in main(): this build adds the probe, so the hollow takes it away', and the first two lines of the body of the main function at line 380 become 'global probe' and a try: 'from cairn.devices.aider_shim.probes import reflection_earns_its_ask as probe' / except ImportError: pass — so with the probe reverted each tooth fails on its own (None has no attribute) and prints red. No other line of the proof changes beyond D1's ticket path. The claimed chain for this repair was written 2026-10-13: the decompose berth that PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m skills.chart.live chain e9b0a8d4fb99 prints, writes_to cairn/devices/aider_shim/probes/reflection_earns_its_ask.py and cairn/devices/aider_shim/proofs/test_reflection_earns_its_ask.py; the August validate and verdict stand. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09; approved thru PROVED (Akien 2026-10-12)
